title: A space — one deliberately empty beat
description: Quarter-note C4, then a space of a quarter (duration is a whole-note fraction: 1/4), then a half-note E4. A space is sequence content that occupies time but draws nothing — not a rest, which is a visible assertion of silence, but an absence, used for voices that genuinely have nothing in part of a bar. The renderer gives the space its column and moves on; the goldens pin the gap.
